Some of my thoughts:

You don't need that much CPU with a 960. Unless you're planning on doing CPU intensive work then you might wanna save a few bucks there. On the same note, the 960 isn't really the greatest deal for a GPU. It's not bad but you might be better off getting something last gen/used.

I HIGHLY recommend getting an SSD. Prices for them are in an absolute freefall and you'll have no problem finding something for less than $.50 a Gb. If you do go this route, don't get any less than 120Gb, but I would recommend a 256Gb one from personal experience.

The PSU you chose is way overkill for the rest of the build. It's a good idea to have a few spare watts but you'll have practically 400 too many. I would say get a 80+ Gold certified PSU with a few less watts.

Finally, I THINK that if you have the Windows 10 dev preview you get full Win 10 for free when it comes out. I may be wrong but it's something to look into.

Overall not a bad build but I think you should take some of my thoughts into consideration as you'll probably be happier in the long run! :)
